issues: Each option label renders twice-concatenated in DOM text (e.g. 'PatnaPATNA', 'BiharBIHAR', 'MrMR') — visually fine (second string is likely a hidden search token / badge), but confuses pure textContent based automation and screen readers. Consider wrapping the code suffix in aria-hidden or visually-hidden spans so getByRole('option', {name}) matches on just the label.

action_items: LOW/DESIGN: v2 Select option DOM text is 'LabelCODE' concatenated — hide the code suffix from accessible name / textContent.
critical_code_review_comments: customer-form POST+PATCH chain now succeeds cleanly — the Phase 11F fix for CustomerIn / ProfileIn accepting catalogue labels & ids works end-to-end.
Booking wizard default_cash_percent is applied from project setup and the UI reflects it in both input values and the split hint — SGH 60/40 and GGV 0/100 both correct.

pp-cap red-state message is a single string concatenated with the link text ('…Revise agreement first.Revise agreement'); fine functionally but splitting the link into its own node would make selector-based assertions cleaner.
